items.title: File Einspruch against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
items.computation: The Bescheid is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday); the date of posting (Aufgabe zur Post) is assumed to be the same date, since no separate posting date is given. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a notice sent by ordinary post is deemed delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the third day after posting, i.e. 22.11.2026 — a Sunday. Because this falls on a Sunday, the statutory extension shifts the deemed delivery to the next business day: Monday, 23.11.2026. (Note: the letter itself states the fiction as 'der vierte Tag' after posting, which does not match the actual statutory rule of the third day under § 122 Abs. 2 AO; the correct legal rule was applied here, not the letter's wording.) The one-month Einspruchsfrist under § 355 Abs. 1 AO begins the day after the deemed bekanntgabe (§ 108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 24.11.2026, and ends one month later on the day bearing the same calendar number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 23.12.2026, a Wednesday, which is not a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday in Saarland, so this is the final day.

warnings: The letter states the postal-delivery fiction as the 'fourth day' after posting ('der vierte Tag nach dem Tag, an dem er zur Post gegeben wurde'), but the actual statutory rule in § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO sets this as the third day after posting; the Einspruch deadline above was computed using the correct legal rule, not the letter's wording — double-check with the Finanzamt if in doubt.
The exact date the notice was actually handed to the postal service (Aufgabe zur Post) is not stated separately in the letter; it was assumed to be the same as the printed document date (19.11.2026).
